name: Custom Shape Badge Reel - US
description:
KEY FEATURES

Keep your ID badge easily accessible while showcasing your unique personality with this Custom Shape Badge Reel. Designed with customizable shapes and vibrant UV-printed artwork, this retractable badge holder combines practicality with personalized style. Perfect for daily use at work, school, hospitals, offices, and events, it securely holds your ID, access card, or keys while adding a fun decorative touch.

 

  • Premium Material:
    - Available in Premium Wood or Premium Acrylic (3mm thickness).
    - Durable retractable ABS plastic badge reel with a strong internal spring mechanism.
    - Features a sturdy metal alligator clip for secure attachment to clothing, pockets, belts, or bags.
    - Equipped with a durable clear vinyl strap and metal snap button for holding ID cards, key cards, or name badges.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Custom Badge Top: Available in three sizes:
    1.57 × 1.57 in (4 × 4 cm)
    1.97 × 1.97 in (5 × 5 cm)
    2.36 × 2.36 in (6 × 6 cm)
    - Badge Reel:
    Reel Diameter: 3.2 cm (1.26 in)
    Adhesive Pad Diameter: 2 cm (0.79 in)
    Retractable Cord Length: 75 cm (29.5 in)
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV Printing Technology.
    - High-definition colors with crisp details and vibrant image quality.
    - Fade-resistant and scratch-resistant for long-lasting durability.
    - Single-sided printing with a clean, professional finish on the front.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    Perfect for everyday use in various environments:
    - Holds employee ID cards, access badges, security cards, and name tags.
    - Ideal for nurses, doctors, teachers, office workers, students, retail staff, and event personnel.
    - Retractable cord provides quick and convenient badge scanning.
    - Personalized custom shape makes it easy to identify your badge while expressing your personality.
    - Can also hold lightweight keys, USB drives, or small accessories.

 

- Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
- A thoughtful personalized gift for professionals, coworkers, teachers, healthcare workers, students, friends, and family.
- Perfect for: Employee Appreciation Gifts, Teacher Appreciation, Nurse Week, Graduation, Back to School, Birthday, Christmas, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Office Parties, New Job Celebration, Retirement, Any special occasion.
- A practical keepsake that combines functionality, personalization, and everyday convenience.

  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days on average (US)

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
